# FHA with Non-Impound Lines

## Procedure
Effective Date: 3/13/20 DP17-ESC355.v01

## Purpose
Loans under the FHA program are expected to have an established escrow account.
If a loan boards without escrow, it needs to be sent back to the originator.

## Scope
This procedure applies to employees in the Escrow Department.

## Procedures

1. Open Google Chrome browser and type rims/ as the web address. Servicing Non Default Escrow Possible Data Issues
2. Review Escrow: FHA with no Escrow Payment
3. Review loans on the report to determine if there is a valid reason the loan is non escrowed.
    - If yes, document reason
    - If no, identify where the loan originated and email that department contact
4. Once the department contact responds on whether it needs to be converted to escrow, proceed to Establish Escrow
5. Document Servicing System with your findings
6. Save the report to the M: drive on a monthly basis
